neo.gia_tri: ROD "Decision Framework for Colorado River Guidelines: Coordinated Operations of Lake Powell and Lake Mead (2027–2036)"; Bộ trưởng Doug Burgum ký ngày 21/08/2026 (chữ ký tay trên trang bìa, kiểm bằng ảnh), David M. Palumbo đề nghị ký 08-21-2026. Khung 10 năm 2027–2036; Operating Guidelines dự kiến theo chu kỳ 2 năm; bộ đầu tiên là 2027–2028 Operating Guidelines. Phương án chọn: Preferred Alternative của Final EIS (31/07/2026) = "Decision Framework". Sideboard cắt Lower Basin tối đa 3,0 maf. Năm 2027 và 2028: Lower Basin cắt 1,25 maf/năm: Arizona 760.000 af, California 440.000 af, Nevada 50.000 af (Nevada còn 250.000 af). Kiện tụng: Nevada + Colorado River Commission of Nevada + SNWA kiện tại D. Nev., Case 2:26-cv-02665, nộp 24/08/2026.
neo.nguon: U.S. Department of the Interior / USBR
neo.trich: Unfortunately, as of the publication of this Record of Decision (ROD), consensus on long-term operations has not been reached. Given the extraordinary importance of the Colorado River, the Secretary of the Interior (Secretary), for the first time in modern history, convened all seven Colorado River Governors multiple times to facilitate a common, consensus- based operational approach to the worsening conditions in the Basin. Despite these efforts, the seven Basin States were unable to reach an agreement. Nevertheless, new operations must begin October 1, 2026.
trich_bo_sung: The Operating Guidelines are anticipated to be issued for 2-year intervals, unless the Secretary determines a different number of years is appropriate. The Secretary will issue each set of Operating Guidelines, subject to applicable environmental compliance, as a final agency action.

Of the 6.25 maf that shall be apportioned each calendar year for consumptive use in the Lower Division States of which 2.04 maf shall be apportioned for use in Arizona, 3.96 maf shall be apportioned for use in California and 250,000 acre-feet (af) shall be apportioned for use in Nevada, reflecting reductions of 760,000 af in Arizona, 440,000 af in California, and 50,000 af in Nevada, in accordance with a Lower Basin implementing agreement(s).

Reclamation also released today the August 2026 24-Month Study , determining the 2027 operations based on the new guidelines. Lake Powell will begin the October 1 water year between elevations 3,540 and 3,510 feet, placing operations in the Lower Elevation Infrastructure Protection Range with an expected water year release between 6.0 and 7.0 million acre-feet. Reclamation will begin the water year with lower releases between 6.0 and 7.0 million acre-feet in order to attempt to maintain an elevation of 3,510 feet or higher and will adjust releases through April to continue to maintain elevation 3,510 feet. The water year 2027 release volume will be determined in April. For Lake Mead, water deliveries to the Lower Basin States will be reduced by 1.25 million-acre feet for calendar year 2027.

neo.trich: (a) There is hereby apportioned from the Colorado River System in perpetuity to the Upper Basin and to the Lower Basin, respectively, the exclusive beneficial consumptive use of 7,500,000 acre-feet of water per annum, which shall include all water necessary for the supply of any rights which may now exist. (b) In addition to the apportionment in paragraph (a), the Lower Basin is hereby given the right to increase its beneficial consumptive use of such waters by one million acre-feet per annum.
trich_bo_sung: who, after negotiations participated in by Herbert Hoover appointed by The President as the representative of the United States of America, have agreed upon the following articles:

(c) If, as a matter of international comity, the United States of America shall hereafter recognize in the United States of Mexico any right to the use of any waters of the Colorado River System, such waters shall be supplied first from the waters which are surplus over and above the aggregate of the quantities specified in paragraphs (a) and (b); and if such surplus shall prove insufficient for this purpose, then, the burden of such deficiency shall be equally borne by the Upper Basin and the Lower Basin,
DONE at the City of Santa Fe, New Mexico, this twenty-fourth day of November, A.D. One Thousand Nine Hundred and Twenty-two.

neo.trich: (1) If sufficient mainstream water is available for release, as determined by the Secretary of the Interior, to satisfy 7,500,000 acre-feet of annual consumptive use in the aforesaid three States, then of such 7,500,000 acre- feet of consumptive use, there shall be apportioned 2,800,000 acre-feet for use in Arizona, 4,400,000 acre-feet for use in California, and 300,000 acre-feet for use in Nevada;
trich_bo_sung: The States of Arizona, California, and Nevada are authorized to enter into an agreement which shall provide (1) that of the 7,500,000 acre-feet annually apportioned to the lower basin by paragraph (a) of Article III of the Colorado River compact, there shall be apportioned to the State of Nevada 300,000 acre-feet and to the State of Arizona 2,800,000 acre-feet for exclusive beneficial consumptive use in perpetuity,

In passing the Boulder Canyon Project Act, Congress intended to, and did, create its own comprehensive scheme for the apportion- ment among California, Arizona and Nevada of the Lower Basin's share of the mainstream waters of the Colorado River, leaving each State her own tributaries. It decided that a fair division of the first 7,500,000 acre-feet of such mainstream waters would give 4,400,000 acre-feet to California, 2,800,000 to Arizona, and 300,000 to Nevada, and that Arizona and California should each get one-half of any surplus.

neo.neo: Đập Hoover: thời gian, tử vong, tên
neo.ket_luan: SAI MỘT PHẦN — khánh thành 30/09/1935 (FDR) ĐÚNG; "hoàn thành 1936" ĐÚNG (mọi hạng mục xong 01/03/1936); 96 là số "chính thức" ĐÚNG; 112 bao gồm cả ca chết 1922
neo.gia_tri: Hợp đồng cho phép 7 năm kể từ 20/04/1931; đổ bê tông xong 29/05/1935; mọi hạng mục xong 01/03/1936. Six Companies trúng thầu 11/03/1931 ($48.890.955). FDR khánh thành "Boulder Dam" 30/09/1935. Tên Hoover Dam chính thức trở lại 1947 (nghị quyết chung của Congress). Lake Mead đặt theo Elwood Mead (Commissioner USBR); bắt đầu tích nước 01/02/1935. Tử vong "chính thức" 96 (industrial fatalities); 112 gồm các ca trước khi đập được phê duyệt (1922). 21.000 người làm, trung bình 3.500, đỉnh 5.218 (06/1934).
neo.nguon: USBR Hoover Dam (FAQ, essay); U.S. Census Bureau "History and the Census: Hoover Dam" (09/2025)
neo.trich: The "official" number of fatalities involved in building Hoover Dam is 96. These were men who died at the dam site (classified as "industrial fatalities") from such causes as drowning, blasting, falling rocks or slides, falls from the canyon walls, being struck by heavy equipment, truck accidents, etc. Industrial fatalities do not include deaths from heat, pneumonia, heart trouble, etc.
trich_bo_sung: some sources cite the number of deaths as 112. But this incorporates incidents that occurred before the dam was authorized, and well in advance of construction.
The contractors were allowed seven years from April 20, 1931, but concrete placement in the dam was completed May 29, 1935, and all features were completed by March 1, 1936.
With the bulk of heavy construction completed, President Franklin D. Roosevelt dedicated Boulder Dam during a September 30, 1935, ceremony
Engineers began filling Lake Mead—named for Elwood Mead , commissioner of the U.S. Bureau of Reclamation—on February 1, 1935.
President Franklin D. Roosevelt dedicated Boulder Dam—named Hoover Dam since 1947—on September 30, 1935.
neo.ghi_chu: MÂU THUẪN nhỏ: City of Las Vegas timeline viết "With the dam completed and dedicated in 1936" — sai về năm khánh thành (1935). Dùng 1935 (khánh thành) và 1936 (hoàn tất). Census story gọi Lake Mead là "the largest water reservoir in the world" — KHÔNG dùng (xem khong_dung).
